name: public-oracle-expert-base
summary: Oracle 知识基座：Connection Types（SID/ServiceName/TNS）、JDBC Driver、Connection Pool、LOB Handling、Character Set。供 devlab-middleware-expert 通过 extends 继承。
runtime_requirements: This is a knowledge base skill, designed to be extended by other skills via the extends mechanism.
Use Service Name connection format, not legacy SID.
Use thin JDBC driver for most cases; thick/OCI only for advanced features.
